propositions: Plan-review attestations must record signed plan-material pins binding each direct child and prerequisite to their current narrow-fingerprint state at review time.
Material drift in a pinned ticket invalidates downstream attestation validity only when enforcement is enabled; disabled enforcement reports drift as advisory.
Pre-sign review re-collects all relationships and fingerprints under the global write lock; any concurrent change aborts the review atomically.
Execution-phase reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority-floor threshold for blocking criteria (except prerequisite-consistency at 0.60) and require compatible floor values in attestations.
Close operations require a current certified plan review when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled; code freshness alone never blocks close.
Prerequisite consistency evaluation receives isolated material for each prerequisite and emits deterministic coverage records mapping consistency, findings, or indeterminate disposition per target.
